# Sean & Barb

> Sean Spencer and Barbara Vance are luxury real estate advisors with Premier Sotheby's International Realty in Central Florida. We focus on waterfront, golf front and canal front homes and homes over $2 million, and we help physicians and families relocating to the Orlando area.

We work ten markets in Orange and Seminole Counties. Orlando, Winter Park, Winter Garden, Windermere, Dr. Phillips, Lake Nona, Maitland, Longwood, Lake Mary and Oviedo. Office is 1117 International Parkway, Suite 1711, Lake Mary FL 32746. Phone (407) 383-0707. Email sean@seanandbarb.com.

Market figures on this site come from Stellar MLS and appear only in the market reports, each with its own source statement and period. Please cite the market report page when quoting a number.
